# traktr

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/da-wi/traktr/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/da-wi/traktr/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

## Overview

The `traktr` package provides a tidy workflow for enriching GPS tracking data from Sentinel-2 imagery and related products. It supports both H3-based and buffer-based areas of interest (AOI), handles tiling, querying and rate-limited downloads from the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE), and attaches contextual statistics back to your GPS data.

## Installation

Simply install from github using the package `devtools` (required since not published on CRAN).

```{r eval=FALSE}
# install.packages("devtools")

# Install the latest version from github
devtools::install_github("da-wi/gps_tracking")
```

### Setup

After installing, you should create an account on https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings and create an OAuth Client there. 

If you did this, set up your `.Renviron` file, that includes the environmental variables for CDSE and the GPS data directory. 

```{r eval=FALSE}
CDSE_CLIENT_ID=myid
CDSE_CLIENT_SECRET=mysecret
GPS_SMB_ROOT="//myserver/GPS"
```

After adapting the files, read in the environmental variables by calling

```{r eval=FALSE}
readRenviron(".Renviron")
```


## Usage

### Read data files

Now, you should be able to read the *.csv files

```{r eval=FALSE}
gps_data <- read_gps_csv(pattern = paste0("^Z.*\\.csv$"))  |> 
  select(subject, timestamp, lat, lon, direction, speed)

df <- gps_data |> dplyr::slice(7000:13000)
```

### Fetch data from CDSE

To fetch satellite imagery from CDSE, we need to create an OAuthClient with the credentials from our account. 
(If you haven't, create new OAuth client here, after logging in https://shapps.dataspace.copernicus.eu/dashboard/#/account/settings). 

These are the credentials you have to put in `.Renviron`.

```{r eval=FALSE}
oauth <- CDSE::GetOAuthClient(id = Sys.getenv("CDSE_CLIENT_ID", ""),
                              secret = Sys.getenv("CDSE_CLIENT_SECRET", ""))

```

After that, we can simply retrieve the data from the server 

```{r eval=FALSE}
df_ndvi_h3_60 <- df |>
  mutate_aoi_h3(lat, lon) |>
  fetch_ndvi(from = as.Date("2025-04-01"),
             to   = as.Date("2025-07-31"),
             out_dir = "output/ndvi_default_2band_60m",
             client  = oauth, 
             res_m = 60 ) |>
  attach_ndvi(out_dir = "output/ndvi_default_2band_60m", summary = "mean") 
```


Simple visualization

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df_ndvi_h3_60 |> filter(lat > 45) , aes(lon, lat, fill = ndvi_mean)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This package is designed for internal use with sensitive GPS data. Example data are not distributed due to privacy restrictions. All users must configure access to their own data sources.
